# Kamakshi's thirty-two acts of charity

`d-kamakshi-32` | Ambal, Parvati, Durga and Kali | 5 songs

At Kanchi the Goddess is said to have performed thirty-two dharmas (aram) as acts of charity; the songs call her the one who did them.
